t: Gorilla or Scotch? definitely order the Gorilla
s: When I ran out after 2 bars I thought ... got 30lb Scotch 3M bad idea. The Gorilla tape is thick and cushy which means it can take some mangling. It cuts clean so taking the 1/4" of tape off the bottom of the bar was easy. The only con is the backing is hard to get off but that means it stays on when you are putting the gorilla tape down. 3M backing came off and bubbled as I was placing the tape plus tape pulls and stretches which means it is hard to keep straight. Buy Gorilla ...   Sponsored
